name: v0.121.0
body:
### Added Features

- OS End of life warnings should account for SupportEnd date from the distro release information [Issue [#3230](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3230)] [PR [#3787](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3787) @tomersein]
- Licensing: copyright owner missing, needed for Debian packaging [Issue [#3501](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3501)] [PR [#3791](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3791) @wagoodman]

### Bug Fixes

- fix(db-build) allow configuring sqlite cache size at db build time [PR [#3814](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3814) @willmurphyscode]
- Carry AlmaLinux fix dates onto replaced RHEL matches [PR [#3773](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3773) @wagoodman]
- carry fix availability through extended support fix merging [PR [#3809](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3809) @bot190]
- upgrade to golang.org/x/net v0.61.0 [PR [#3802](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3802) @westonsteimel]
- Swift Package Manager packages miss GitHub Swift advisories (searched by identity, not repository path) [Issue [#3795](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3795)] [PR [#3713](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3713) @az-catch]

### Additional Changes

- bump go-make module and action together [PR [#3793](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3793) @wagoodman]

### Dependencies

50 dependency changes (47 updated, 1 added, 2 removed). 5 vulnerabilities remediated.

name: v0.120.0
body:
### Added Features

- Mark SLES as a comprehensive distro [PR [#3732](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3732) @willmurphyscode]
- Store NVD SSVC decision points in a new v6 decorator table [PR [#3725](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3725) @wagoodman]
- Adding Locations column to html template which help with triaging [PR [#3092](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3092) @santrancisco]

### Bug Fixes

- sign release checksums with a sigstore bundle [PR [#3759](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3759) @wagoodman]
- chainguard osv package ecosystem should be package type [PR [#3758](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3758) @kzantow]
- include qualifiers for unaffected packages [PR [#3734](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3734) @kzantow]
- render TUI log lines on their own rows, with colors and a small header [PR [#3735](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3735) @wagoodman]
- `match.dpkg.using-cpes` (and `match.rpm.using-cpes`) is accepted but has no effect [Issue [#3746](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3746)] [PR [#3747](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3747) @amitschendel]
- embedded spaces in bin location breaks install.sh [Issue [#2809](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/2809)] [PR [#3738](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3738) @bIackr0se]
- False positives: --add-cpes-if-none maps tomcat-embed-el to apache:tomcat CPE [Issue [#3730](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3730)]
- `match.rpm.using-cpes` has no effect [Issue [#3752](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3752)] [PR [#3753](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3753) @amitschendel]
- Import metadata digest is not in the expected format [Issue [#3388](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3388)]
- Issue Pulling DB update [Issue [#3586](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3586)]

name: v0.119.0
body:
### Added Features

- Expose distro-fixed dropped matches via ignoredMatches so `--show-suppressed` can surface them [Issue [#3450](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3450)] [PR [#3705](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3705) @philroche]
- Licensing: copyright owner missing, needed for Debian packaging [Issue [#3501](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3501)]

### Bug Fixes

- fixes typo in cpe example input for cpe-direct scan [PR [#3679](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3679) @zhill]
- `--by-cve`: which advisory record survives the merge varies between runs [Issue [#3630](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3630)]

### Additional Changes

- Docs missing for include-aliases [Issue [#3663](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3663)] [PR [#3671](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3671) @dev-rehaann]

body:
### Added Features

- duplicate RHSAs to all applicable RHEL minor versions [PR [#3542](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3542) @willmurphyscode]

- populate package architecture for matching [PR [#3504](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3504) @willmurphyscode]
- lightweight reachability analysis to reduce Golang false positives [Issue [#2960](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/2960)] [PR [#3509](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3509) @spiffcs]
- Deduplicate Go matches that are aliases of each other (same CVE reported under both a `govulndb` GO-* ID and its GHSA) [Issue [#3511](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3511)] [PR [#3509](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3509) @spiffcs]
- Support Ubuntu ESM [Issue [#3544](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3544)] [PR [#3546](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3546) @wagoodman]

- regenerate v6.1.8 blob and sql schemas [PR [#3574](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3574) @spiffcs]

- Grype doesn't match u-boot in SBOM if type is set to firmware [Issue [#2537](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/2537)]
- Ignore Go compiler affecting CVE when Docker image only contains a binary compiled with Go [Issue [#1782](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/1782)]
- Zarf scans emit warnings for consistently unreadable files (i.e., included non-SBOMs) [Issue [#3516](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3516)] [PR [#3545](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3545) @brandtkeller]
- Fail parsing github actions [Issue [#3220](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3220)]

### Added Features

- emit golang.org/x/net vulns from govlundb [PR [#3534](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3534) @willmurphyscode]
- Merge Go vuln matches with GHSA matches [Issue [#3515](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3515)]

### Bug Fixes

- only emit records for stdlib [PR [#3527](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3527) @willmurphyscode]
- mark hummingbird distro as rolling [PR [#3521](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3521) @willmurphyscode]
- disable go stdlib CPE matching by default [PR [#3517](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3517) @willmurphyscode]
- merge in custom ranges when applicable [PR [#3514](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3514) @willmurphyscode]
- exclude linux-kbuild deb indirect matches by default [PR [#3506](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3506) @westonsteimel]
- avoid panic on invalid RHEL version IDs [PR [#3490](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3490) @jspilman]
- Support reading CycloneDX 1.7 SBOMs [Issue [#3373](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3373)]
- Grype cannot read mariadb version correctly [Issue [#3452](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3452)]
- grype hangs when downloading certain images using registry client [Issue [#3492](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3492)]
- Can we get a fix for these Critical findings reported for grype [Issue [#3484](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3484)]

### Additional Changes

- Security: bump golang.org/x/crypto to v0.52.0 to resolve multiple CVEs [Issue [#3493](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3493)]
- Security: bump golang.org/x/net to v0.55.0 to resolve CVEs [Issue [#3494](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3494)]

### Dependencies

35 dependency changes (31 updated, 3 added, 1 removed). 5 vulnerabilities remediated.

**🟢 Remediated (5)**

- [GHSA-33vj-92qq-66hc](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-33vj-92qq-66hc) (High) — github.com/containerd/containerd/v2
- [GHSA-cvxm-645q-p574](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cvxm-645q-p574) (Medium) — github.com/containerd/containerd/v2
- [GHSA-jpcc-p29g-p8mq](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-jpcc-p29g-p8mq) (Medium) — github.com/containerd/containerd/v2
- [GHSA-rgh6-rfwx-v388](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rgh6-rfwx-v388) (High) — github.com/containerd/containerd/v2
- [GHSA-xhf5-7wjv-pqxp](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xhf5-7wjv-pqxp) (High) — github.com/containerd/containerd/v2
